scope: Fresh Linux debug Flutter process + real embedded libmpv, 1366x768 native fullscreen, synthetic clip; /proc CPU percent of one core. UI input only; no VM method invocation. Short samples, not profiler or p95.
memory_conclusion: PROVISIONAL: short debug observation; RSS increased during burst, FD count stable. No long-duration heap/leak proof. Synthetic replica tests bound 500 chat and 1000 reactions.
discarded_measurements: Earlier VM-invoked runs interfered with Flutter timers and are excluded. Android PSS from that run is also excluded.
